d: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) Chaman Tuhin Kanta Pandey delivers the keynote address at the 17th Capital Market Conference organized by ASSOCHAM, detailing regulatory reforms under the framework of optimum regulation. Addressing industry leaders, he highlights that India's securities market is valued at over ₹500 trillion, exceeding 130 percent of the nation's GDP.
